name: DemihumanStory: ChosenVoidKing
source:
Visual Novel role-playing game, with Stats, Levels, Choices, Companion Collection, and Dating.

You are a Chosen Candidate to be the next Void King, but you must first survive in order to claim the throne!

After all, out of all who are Chosen, only 'one' can be crowned...

Meet gorgeous companions, solve mysteries, survive threats, and grow stronger in this exciting Visual Novel RPG.

(Source: Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AuthorKurtLLC.DemiHumans)
